observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly (front lamp) with a clear lens and black housing.
The headlight lens has visible reflections; no clear readable brand/model text is visible in the photo.
No other parts (engine/suspension/AC components) are shown.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Only a single headlight assembly is shown in photo 0; no body/engine/suspension/AC parts are pictured.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (vehicle make/model/year) for the headlight assembly.
risks.proof: A photo of the headlight label/part number (sticker or molded code) and a photo showing the mounting side/connector type; also ask for the exact car model/year it fits.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used headlight with uncertain fitment (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in the photo (cracked lens, moisture inside, broken internal reflectors, damaged mounting tabs).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens edges, mounting tabs, and the inside reflector; plus a short video showing it powered on (beam pattern).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to be fully functional/undamaged.

risks.risk: Missing components (bulbs, ballast/driver, wiring harness, leveling motor) depending on the headlight type.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (bulb/ballast/driver, wiring connector, any leveling motor) and confirmation of what is included.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any part number/label on the headlight (sticker or molded code).
Confirm the exact vehicle make/model/year it fits (and whether it’s left or right side).
Send photos of mounting tabs and the back connector area.
Send a short video powering it on to confirm it works and show beam pattern.
response.reason: The photo shows a car headlight assembly, but the seller’s text claims body/engine/suspension parts for multiple brands. Without part number/fitment and functional condition proof, a reliable price cannot be set.
